messages.subject: Number of IndCovs
parts:
Hello, everyone!!!!,

Good morning

I have a general question: How many individual covariants can be added to the model (oSCR.fit, see "indCovs" )? 

I have seen that the sex of the animal can be added as an individual covariant. But can I add one or two additional individual covariants to the model? For example, if the animal is white or blue. Or an individual covariant indicating a particular behaviour performed by the animal (present or absent). 

Or the model works only with 1 individual covariants (i.e. sex attribute)?

There are one example using more than 1 individual covariant?

Thanks!!!

Victor

messages.author: 527d9b3ec7deff2d
messages.subject: Re: Number of IndCovs
parts: Hi Victor, right now oSCR only works with 1 individual covariate and it must be a binary variable.  Does not need to be sex, per se.
